imageLimitations: No native meeting screenshot was found in repository evidence. Meeting is reconstructed from current SwiftUI source, not claimed to be a screenshot or a pixel-exact native rendering.

notes: NotesPanel defaults to 420 by 510 points; hides title and native traffic lights.
DailyNotesView uses a 34-point header: xmark, date-chevron button, today remaining-task capsule, optional return-to-today arrow, and pin/pin.fill.
Date button opens a 348-point calendar popover. Picking another day does not itself dismiss the popover; clicking outside dismisses it.
Calendar has Monday-first columns, month navigation, task completion counts, a return-to-today button, and selected-day task preview.
Today's remaining-task count stays tied to today when viewing another date.
Editor is a Milkdown WKWebView; body font 18 is an actual supported preference. Editor padding, title styles and checkbox paths follow bundled source.
No permanent date sidebar, saved-file footer, separate titlebar, or textual pin button exists in the real note UI. These prior inventions were removed.
The note content and dates are synthetic demo data; calendar cells correspond to October 2026. The native window is displayed at 1.45x without changing its aspect ratio.
meeting: showLibrary creates a 900 by 600 content window titled 会议转写.
MeetingLibraryView uses NavigationSplitView, a meeting list with minimum 210-point sidebar, and a detail region with 20-point padding.
Meeting titles derive from start-date formatting; the fabricated editable 发布讨论 title was removed.
Detail header contains 打开录音文件夹, 播放录音 / 停止播放, and 复制全文 buttons.

Apple 本地稿 / Soniox 增强稿 uses a 300-point segmented picker. It is disabled when there is no cloud text. A ready local record with no cloud result exposes 上传到 Soniox; the demo does not activate that button.
Transcript lines have HH:MM:SS timestamps, source/speaker labels and selectable text. Playback does not animate highlights or expose a progress slider in current UI.
copy() writes the transcript to the pasteboard and does not show an in-app success toast. Copy confirmation in this film is external editorial text.
The five-second excerpt starts with an existing local transcript and demonstrates playback, stop and copy. It makes no claim that long audio is transcribed within the scene duration.
A shared camera plane crops toward the detail view; both UI and pointer undergo identical translation and scale.

MeetingProcessor actually runs FluidAudio locally and carries optional speaker labels, but its generated labels are source-speakerID, not 说话人 1/2. This excerpt uses the real source fallback labels 麦克风 / 系统声音 and makes no identity-recognition claim.

verification.determinism: All changing application state reads interactionAt.done/progress/since. Pointer and state share the same exported action table.
verification.domTargets: Each clickable target has a matching data-action-target attribute; the playback button lists both play-recording and stop-recording.
verification.rendering: Root agent owns browser, DOM-hit and frame-image validation; this worker did not open a browser or launch a render.
